standard-dialogue.npc: Ah, this is a strange ritual that has been going on for generations.
One of our clan stands on this tower and shouts insults at the other side.

standard-dialogue.player: I'm surprised your Burgher approves of this sort of thing.

standard-dialogue.npc: He suggested stopping it, but there was resistance from the rest of the village. We find it therapeutic.

options.text: Can I watch? I like odd rituals.

steps.player: Can I watch? I like odd rituals.

steps.text: Continues below at Watching the shouting

options.text: Oh well, I'd better get going

steps.player: Oh well, I'd better get going

watching-the-shouting.speaker: Guard (Jatizso tower)
watching-the-shouting.text: YOU WOULDN'T KNOW HOW TO KILL A TROLL IF IT CAME UP AND BIT YER ARM OFF!

watching-the-shouting.speaker: Guard (Neitiznot tower)
watching-the-shouting.text: YOU WOULDN'T KNOW HOW TO SHAVE A YAK IF YOUR LIFE DEPENDED ON IT!

watching-the-shouting.speaker: Guard (Jatizso tower)
watching-the-shouting.text: CALL THAT A TOWN, I'VE SEEN BETTER HAMLETS!

watching-the-shouting.speaker: Guard (Jatizso tower)
watching-the-shouting.text: AND YOUR FATHER SMELLED OF WINTERBERRIES.

watching-the-shouting.speaker: Guard (Neitiznot tower)
watching-the-shouting.text: AT LEAST WE HAVE SOMETHING OTHER THAN SMELLY FISH!

watching-the-shouting.speaker: Guard (Jatizso tower)
watching-the-shouting.text: OUR KING'S BETTER THAN YOUR BURGHER!
Both guards continue to shout the names of their islands at each other
